title: HB0948 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 36; Title 39 and Title 40, relative to firearms dispossession.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2025-02-06; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260513072802 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/114/Bill/HB0948.pdf (LegiScan doc 3104886))

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 36-3-625(a)(1)): (1) That the respondent is required to dispossess any firearm in the respondent's possession by transferring the firearm to a law enforcement agency designated by the court within forty-eight (48) hours of the issuance of the order;
SECTION 3 (TCA 36-3-625(b)(2)): (2) To complete and return to the court within three (3) business days of the issuance of the order: (A) A copy of the receipt from the law enforcement agency demonstrating the law enforcement agency's receipt of the firearm; and
SECTION 6 (TCA 39-13-111(c)(6)(A)): (A) Terminate physical possession of any firearm in the defendant's possession by transferring the firearm to a law enforcement agency designated by the court within forty-eight (48) hours of the issuance of the order; and
SECTION 7 (TCA 39-13-111(c)(6)(B)): (B) Complete and return to the court in which the defendant was convicted within three (3) business days: (i) An affidavit of firearms dispossession form; and (ii) A copy of the receipt from the law enforcement agency demonstrating the law enforcement agency's receipt of the firearm.
SECTION 5 (TCA 36-3-625(g)): (g) A law enforcement agency designated by the court to receive a respondent's firearm pursuant to subdivision (a)(1) shall at the time of the surrender issue to the respondent a receipt identifying all firearms that have been surrendered.
SECTION 11 (uncodified): The administrative office of the courts shall develop the affidavit of firearms dispossession form required by § 39-13-111(c)(6)(B)(i).
